notes.en: [[character:alyosha]] is a [[element:stellar-conduct]] support who is also capable of providing healing to the active character with his companion, Tugarin, whom is summoned by his [[ability:burst]]. Using his [[ability:skill]], or the end of a [[ability:na]] string will apply the Hunter's Mark, which, when consumed by [[character:alyosha]] using those aformentioned abilities, or if the target with a mark is struck by Tugarin, will grant the team the Hunter's Precision effect, which boosts their ATK when on the field. [[character:alyosha]]'s [[ability:burst]] is also capable of taunting enemies.

[[character:alyosha]]'s [C1] gives him 15 Energy when a teammate triggers an [[element:electro]]-related reaction, effectively changing his [[ability:burst]] cost from 70 to 55. This has a cooldown of 18 seconds.
[[character:alyosha]]'s [C2] increases his [[ability:burst]] duration by 6 seconds, and also lets Tugarin apply Hunter's Mark to opponents. This does not active previously existing Hunter's Marks.
[[character:alyosha]]'s [C4] allows Tugarin to also heal a teammate with the lowest HP at half of the effectiveness.
[[character:alyosha]]'s [C6] allows Hunter's Precision to stack up to 2 times. Characters affected by both stacks of Hunter's Precision also get a 100 [[stat:em]] increase.
